outcome: duration of first stage of labor
duration of second stage of labor
incidence of maternal complications (nausea and vomiting)
cohort: Eighty healthy women undergoing labor epidural analgesia.
finding: Low concentration of epidural ropivacaine combined with dexmedetomidine reduces pain without increasing motor blockage, hemodynamic instability, labor duration, or complications.
mod_finding: The rate of instrumental delivery and cesarean section did not show significant difference between the two groups.
